request.description: A single finely crafted mining PICKAXE item icon, native 64x64 pixel art for a polished fantasy roguelike mobile game. One elegant gently curved double-ended steel pick head, icy silver-blue steel bevels with crisp white edge highlights and deep navy underside, small brass fastening ring with one visible rivet, warm reddish oak handle with subtle grain, dark leather grip wrap and a small brass pommel. Diagonal handle from lower-left to upper-right, pick head across the upper half. Compact balanced readable silhouette, dark selective 1-pixel outline, deliberate clusters, four-tone materials, light from upper-left. Entire tool visible with 5px transparent padding. No background, no rocks, no gems, no flames, no sparkle particles, no frame, no letters. Only one beautifully rendered pickaxe.
